touch.right side: Fire, grenade, rescue, melee, ability, dash

description: Seeded left-to-right action roguelite with 16 race/class builds, rescues, destructible fortresses, and optional wave, chrono-lock, or turn-based modes.
instructions: Choose a route (procedural roguelite or special Wave Mode) and clock (Real-time, Chrono-lock, or turn-based). Scout and fight east. Touch linked crew or press E nearby to recruit their random race/class build; deaths consume rescues last-to-first, then grant your starting build its final life. Keep one infinite starter and one limited-ammo pickup; ammo packs refill it. Space jumps, W/Up climbs, F melee, C ability, Shift dash, Q grenade, 1/2 swap, R redeploy.
